COMPRESS-83.label: I
COMPRESS-83.reason: This is in the compression package, but it concerns Gzip output buffering and write delegation, not ZIP archive input parsing or truncated-stream detection. No shared mechanism with `ZipArchiveInputStream.read()` or multi-volume archive handling.

COMPRESS-85.label: P
COMPRESS-85.reason: Same archive-processing subsystem, and it involves a corrupted/truncated final entry in an archive. That gives useful regional context around end-of-archive handling and incomplete data detection, though the format is cpio rather than zip and the mechanism is archive creation/extraction integrity rather than stream-read truncation detection.

COMPRESS-86.label: I
COMPRESS-86.reason: This is tar header metadata generation for longname entries, which is a different archive format and a different failure mode. It shares only the broad compression/archivers package, with no meaningful overlap in read-path truncation logic or stream error handling.
